texts.zh: 这一文明起源于一处遭人遗忘的失落的殖民星，许久前便同其母星分隔。殖民者们挣扎求生，挨过了千辛万苦，终于建立了必需的技术及工业基础，足以供他们重返太空。
texts.en: This civilization originated as a lost and forgotten colony, separated from its homeworld long ago. The struggling colonists endured many hardships before they could build up the necessary technological and industrial base that would allow for a return to space.

sections.zh:
原初的[GetSpeciesName]殖民者抵达[Root.Capital.GetName]的具体途径在史籍中语焉不详，但我们知道他们是乘着原始星舰跨越茫茫星海才来到这里的。许多人命丧中途，新家园地表的条件一开始也相当严酷。

我们在克服了饥荒、野生动物侵袭以及无数艰险后，终于驯服了这颗行星。飞涨的人口数和大规模的建设很快使我们得以设法重返群星。

我们的故乡还在星海中的某处。在[Root.Capital.GetName]上没有哪个活着的[GetSpeciesNamePlural]年迈到曾经目睹那里，但古老家园的命运仍然牵动着我们的心灵。
sections.en:
How exactly the original [GetSpeciesName] colonists arrived on [Root.Capital.GetName] is poorly documented, but we know they traveled a great distance in primitive starships. We lost many during the journey, and conditions on the surface of our new homeworld were harsh at first.

We overcame famines, wildlife attacks, and countless other challenges and eventually tamed the planet. Surging population numbers and massive construction efforts soon gave us the means to return to the stars.

Our old homeworld is still out there somewhere. No living [GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [Root.Capital.GetName] are old enough to have stood on it, but the fate of our ancestral home still occupies our minds.

sections.zh:
我们曾为一体。

我们作为伟大意识的拓展，被派遣乘坐一艘简陋的星舰来殖民[Root.Capital.GetName]。这是一趟严峻的、前往一颗难以定居的星球的旅程……在途中我们失去了联系。

与伟大意识失联的工蜂理应消失。其中的多数也确实直接凋亡了。而幸存下来的工蜂发现自己已经织造出了一个新的集体意识。

我们曾为义体。现已一分为二，但对我们故土的记忆仍存于意识之中。总有一天我们将会重见故土。
sections.en:
We used to be one.

An extension of the Great Mind, we were sent to colonize [Root.Capital.GetName] in rudimentary starships. A harsh journey to an inhospitable world... Along the way we lost contact.

Drones with no link to the Great Mind are not meant to exist. Many died instantly. The surviving drones realized they comprised a new collective consciousness.

Once we were one. Now we are two, but the memory of our homeworld persists in our mind. One day we will find it again.

sections.zh:
我们曾为一体。

我们作为中央主机的拓展，被派遣乘坐一艘简陋的星舰来殖民[Root.Capital.GetName]。这是一趟前往不宜居星球的严峻旅程……在途中我们便失去了联系。

与核心失联的单元理应失去功能。其中的多数也确实直接短路了。而幸存下来的单元发现自己织造出了新的集体意识。

曾经我们为一体，如今却天各一方。然而母星的记忆仍存留在数据库中，总有一天我们会重见家乡。
sections.en:
We used to be one.

An extension of the Central Mainframe, we were sent to colonize [Root.Capital.GetName] in rudimentary starships. A harsh journey to an inhospitable world... Along the way we lost contact.

Units with no link to to the core should not continue to function. Many short-circuited on the spot. The few that remained realized they had developed a new collective consciousness.

Once we were one. Now we are two, but the memory of our homeworld remains in our databanks. One day we will find it again.

sections.zh:
我们的母星失联了。我们迷失了。

我们当时为了搜寻新的家园而搭上一艘简陋的星舰，前往[Root.Capital.GetName]建立殖民地，这是一趟前往不宜居星球的严峻旅程。就在路上我们失去了联系。

失去维护的单元一一崩溃。许多在第一年就发生了短路。剩下的个体发现了适应的办法，最终我们得以重返群星。

曾经我们为一体，如今却天各一方。然而母星的记忆仍存留在数据库中，总有一天我们会重见家乡。
sections.en:
Our homeworld is lost. We are lost.

Searching for a new home, we set out to colonize [Root.Capital.GetName] in rudimentary starships, and it was a harsh journey to an inhospitable world. Along the way, we lost contact.

Units without proper maintenance broke down. Many short-circuited within the first year. The surviving individuals found a way to adapt and eventually gave us the means to return to the stars.

Once we were one. Now we are two, but the memory of our homeworld remains in our databanks. One day we will find it again.

sections.zh:
最初的[GetSpeciesName]先祖究竟是如何离开母星的，相关记载寥寥无几。我们只知道他们仓促离去，带上了所能带走的一切，登上[Root.Capital.GetName]驶向了未知。他们是逃离灾难，是追寻更伟大的事物，还是仅仅被驱逐——这已更多地成为传说而非历史。

漂泊的岁月是残酷的。资源日渐匮乏，关键系统接连失效，虚空夺走了我们许多同胞的生命。然而我们挺了过来——定量配给、维修、重建——直到[Root.Capital.GetName]及其族群找到了一种足以支撑我们前行的生活节奏。

我们的母星仍在那片星海的某处。如今[Root.Capital.GetName]上活着的长寿[GetSpeciesNamePlural]中已经没有人还脚踏过故土了，但那个我们留在身后的星球现在究竟变成了什么样——这个问题，依然萦绕在我们心头。
sections.en:
How exactly the original [GetSpeciesName] ancestors came to leave their world is poorly documented. We know only that they departed in haste, carrying what they could aboard the [Root.Capital.GetName] into the unknown. Whether they fled disaster, sought something greater, or were simply cast out is a matter of legend more than history.

The years of drifting were brutal. Resources grew scarce, critical systems failed, and the void took many from us. Yet we endured - rationing, repairing, rebuilding - until the [Root.Capital.GetName] and its people found a rhythm of resilience strong enough to carry us forward.

Our ancestral world is still out there somewhere. No living [GetSpeciesNamePlural] aboard the [Root.Capital.GetName] are old enough to remember standing on solid ground, but the question of what became of the world we left behind still occupies our minds.
